subject: selecting the nodes connected by selected edges

messages.author: aba808a7b471253f
messages.subject: selecting the nodes connected by selected edges
parts:
Benjamin asks:

Is there an easy way to activate the "Select --> nodes connected by
selected edges" feature in cytoscape via rCytoscape? i didn't see
this in the list of functions, but perhaps i overlooked it?

We forgot to implement this one, along with its companion: select
edges between selected nodes. They are both on the todo list, but in
the mean time, here is a workaround.

- Paul

selectNodesConnectedBySelectedEdges = function (cw) {
selectedEdges = getSelectedEdges (cw)
if (length (selectedEdges) == 1 && is.na (selectedEdges))
return ()
tokens = unlist (strsplit (selectedEdges, ' '))
node.names = intersect (tokens, nodes (cw@graph))
if (length (node.names) > 0)
selectNodes (cw, node.names)
}
